mechanisms.kill_test: Verify the identity pointwise using strict increase of the moduli.

mechanisms.kill_test: Build nested CRT complements with the first compatible active point before one mixing period.

mechanisms.kill_test: Search exact finite blocks maximising aggregate spike mass under distinct increasing moduli.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/longrun_findings.md: aggregate cross-scale summability is the unresolved core

mechanisms.kill_test: Optimise onset blocks with constant density budget but separated scales.
